unit.why: This is a copied letter from R. Gershon Kitover in Jerusalem to the Besht (1756). It gives family news: his wife's death, his plan to remarry and come back abroad, and his daughter's match. It reports personal news but has no narrative episode.
unit.boundary_note: Letter appended at the end of the book; the scribe's note 'העתקתי מגוף כתב קדשו' closes it. The previous division's story is separate.
